summary: Comprehensive QA Audit Complete - Iteration 14. All 38 new tests passed covering authentication/security, payment flows, session lifecycle, notification system, admin panel, and error handling. Combined with iterations 12-13, total of 71 tests all passing.

frontend_issues.note: Frontend testing skipped as per request - backend only testing

critical_code_review_comments: All authentication endpoints working correctly with proper validation (password length, required fields)
Rate limiting working correctly - 10/min for login, 5/min for signup
Protected endpoints properly reject requests without token (401/403) and with invalid tokens (401)
Payment flows working correctly with real Stripe PaymentIntents: membership=$19.99, weekly boost=$49.99, monthly boost=$149.99
Double-subscription prevention working (400/409 returned for active membership)
Boost purchase authorization checks working - non-trainers get 403, non-owners get 403/404
Session lifecycle fully working: accept, decline, end, client-confirm-end all functioning correctly
Only trainers can accept/decline/end sessions (403/400 returned for non-trainers)
GET session properly requires authentication and only allows participants/admin to view
Notification preferences system working - defaults returned, updates applied correctly
Admin panel properly secured - all endpoints return 403 for non-admin users
Admin dashboard returns proper statistics for admin users
Admin delete user working correctly for admin users
Error handling proper - invalid ObjectId returns 400/404/422 (not 500), non-existent resources return 404
Trainer search and profile endpoints working correctly
seed_data_creation: Created test sessions directly via MongoDB for lifecycle tests. Created test users for payment tests (cleaned up after each test). Test notification preferences cleaned up after tests.
